note: Hand-edited demo merchandising. python3 db/build_db.py merges this onto the spreadsheet, catalog, and measured model data. Edit this file to change brands, copy, stock, shipping, sponsored ranks, and swatch names. Hex values are computed from each model's build.py.

brands.name: Cloudline Home
brands.blurb: Modern upholstered seating. The Cloudline sofa and the charcoal modular sectional come from this house.

brands.name: Harbor House
brands.blurb: Coastal seating in washed linen with driftwood legs. The Harbor loveseat is the house sofa.

brands.name: Lumen Works
brands.blurb: Floor and table lamps, from the satin reading arc to the brass soft-glow shade.

brands.name: Oakline Studio
brands.blurb: Wood and slate tables, including the Oakline round coffee table and the slim birch side table.

brands.name: Loom & Field
brands.blurb: Living-room rugs: a geometric 8x10 and a soft neutral 5x7.

brands.name: Northglass
brands.blurb: Slim smart TVs with a dark bezel and a Screen material the viewer can swap.

brands.name: Verdure
brands.blurb: Floor plants in ceramic and terracotta, from fiddle leaf and monstera to olive.

F001.short_description: Low modern sofa in oatmeal linen with a slim dark leg, built to anchor a living room.

F002.short_description: Two-seat coastal loveseat in washed linen with driftwood legs and a navy pillow.

F003.short_description: Deep modular sectional in charcoal cloth with oatmeal and stone throw pillows.

F004.short_description: Satin-black arc floor lamp with a warm diffuser, sized to swing over a reading chair.

F005.short_description: Brass table lamp with a cream shade and a soft glowing bulb.

F006.short_description: Tripod floor lamp in honey oak and brass with a linen drum shade.

F007.short_description: Round whitewashed-oak coffee table, low enough to sit in front of a sofa.

F008.short_description: Nesting tables with slate tops and black metal frames.

F009.short_description: Narrow birch side table with a recessed tray top.

F010.short_description: Eight-by-ten geometric rug in ivory, teal, and rust.

F011.short_description: Five-by-seven neutral rug with a soft sand field and a deeper border.

F012.short_description: 48-inch smart TV with a thin black bezel and a dark glass screen.

F013.short_description: 65-inch smart TV in a graphite bezel, the larger of the two Northglass panels.

F014.short_description: Tall fiddle-leaf plant in a terracotta pot with a cream slip band.

F015.short_description: Upright snake plant in a pale ceramic pot, with yellow-edged green blades.

F016.short_description: Floor monstera in a banded terracotta pot, with split deep-green leaves.

F017.short_description: Potted olive tree with silvery leaves in a warm clay planter.
